name: dot-shader-image
title: Dot shader image
description: Image rendered as solid and hollow dots on a white, blue, or black surface.
usage: Brand imagery from any picture: `src` (a logo, icon or product shot, best as a PNG with a transparent background), `surface` (`white`, `blue` or `black`) and an optional `size`. Pass `states` to draw dots shaded elsewhere. Graphics sit behind or beside content.
avoid: The image in its own colors next to the dots
notes:
The image is shaded in the browser. Until it is, or if it cannot be read, the surface and its ring backdrop rest on
their own; the dots then fade in once (200ms, ease-out), with no transition under reduced motion. Colors are brand
tokens (`--ds-color-brand`, `--ds-color-white`, `--ds-color-black`), so a theme applies. Give `alt` when the picture
carries meaning; without it the picture is decorative.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
